mutations.name: M1 invert the conditioning strength ordering
mutations.defect: treat 'we found a reason' as STRENGTHENING the finding — the central inversion this build must not permit

mutations.name: M2 stop counting goals as explaining events
mutations.defect: watch only for red cards. A goal is the most common cause of a violent move, so this files almost every goal-driven move under the STRONGEST state

mutations.name: M3 count a yellow card as a dismissal
mutations.defect: match any card as a sending-off; 68 of 72 measured card events were yellows, so this explains away almost every match

mutations.name: M4 read a null xG as zero
mutations.defect: the hollow-value-as-answer failure this repo has been burned by twice; says 'created nothing' about a competition that simply is not covered

mutations.name: M5 let an empty event feed rule out a cause
mutations.defect: treat an empty events array as 'nothing happened' and award the STRONGEST state — the results:0 mistake

mutations.name: M6 resolve an ambiguous join by picking the first
mutations.defect: silently pick one of two matching fixtures; attaches another match's red card to this market

mutations.name: M7 let a too-early read downgrade a measured presence
mutations.defect: one 4th-minute empty read erases a presence measured at 73' — converting missing evidence into a conclusion

mutations.name: M8 alert on an OBSERVED conditioning event
mutations.defect: broadcast a move that HAS a visible cause as an anomaly — the inference direction, inverted at the alert gate

mutations.name: M9 in-play alerts default ON
mutations.defect: promote a context finding to Son's channel without his decision

mutations.name: M10 import the live-stats surface into the lock path
mutations.defect: a temporal-leakage route: live xG reachable from the module that writes the canonical T-10 lock

mutations.name: M11 promote the hunter dispatch off the detail channel
mutations.defect: put in-play model numbers on the act-now channel and the phone

mutations.name: M12 accept xGA as xG
mutations.defect: read the opponent's expected-goals-against as this team's xG

mutations.name: M13 spend requests even with no candidate
mutations.defect: sweep the world every cycle instead of only when an overreaction exists — burns the metered quota

mutations.name: M14 use a cached PRESENT verdict as a shortcut
mutations.defect: let a row assert xG values nobody looked up, by trusting a cached presence instead of reading
